lines.text: Jesus sends two disciples into the city, where they find everything as He described and prepare the Passover.
At evening Jesus arrives with the Twelve and says one of them, dipping into the bowl, will betray Him.
Jesus breaks bread and calls it His body, then calls the cup His blood of the covenant.
Jesus says He will drink the vine's fruit anew in the temple courts, and after rising will go ahead into Galilee.
After a hymn they go to Gethsemane, where Jesus says Peter will deny Him three times before the rooster crows twice.
